question: Where are an attraction located within a 90 kilometers range toward the east of ABQ BioPark (Botanic Garden), Albuquerque, NM?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p WHERE p.tourism = 'attraction' AND ST_DWithin( p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%ABQ BioPark (Botanic Garden)%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Albuquerque%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NM%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 90000 ) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%ABQ BioPark (Botanic Garden)%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Albuquerque%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NM%' LIMIT 1 ), p.geometry )) BETWEEN 67.5 AND 112.5;
